schema.description: A2 — Governing chain. Owning Corporation and the deduplicated set of Ecosystems whose schemas the DID participates in.

id.description: Stable `uint64` primary key of the Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.id`).

did.description: The Corporation's own declared DID (mirrors VPR `Corporation.did`). Identity only — the DID's trust state lives on the `Did` node (A1 / referential lookup).

policyAddress.description: On-chain account that signs on behalf of this Corporation (mirrors VPR `Corporation.policy_address`). Globally unique across all Corporation entries. MAY be backed by any signing primitive (single key, multisig, Cosmos SDK group policy, …).
policyAddress.title: traverse_response_Bech32Address
